name: DukaanSaathi AI
description: Street Vendor Digitalization Agent: shop profile, product catalogue and marketing content for Indian street vendors, written with IBM Granite (or a labelled demo template) and approved by the vendor.
note: Project descriptor for this FastAPI app. It is not a LangFlow export.

stack.ai: IBM Granite via IBM watsonx.ai (IBM Cloud Lite), optional

ibm.status: Live call not yet verified with real credentials; confirm model and Lite quota in your IBM Cloud account.

environment_variables.IBM_API_KEY: placeholder, set in .env or Vercel settings (never commit)
environment_variables.IBM_PROJECT_ID: placeholder, set in .env or Vercel settings

modes.ibm-granite: Used when IBM_API_KEY and IBM_PROJECT_ID are set and DEMO_MODE is not true. A failed IBM call returns HTTP 502; there is no silent fallback.
modes.demo: Labelled template text, not AI output. Used when IBM keys are missing or DEMO_MODE is true.

data.where: Shop profile, products and saved messages are stored in the vendor's browser (localStorage). The server stores nothing.
data.backup: Download backup / Restore backup buttons on the My shop page (JSON file).
data.reason: Vercel serverless functions have no persistent disk, so a server-side SQLite file is lost between requests.

workflow: Vendor picks a task, product, festival and language
Browser checks the input and sends shop and product details to the API
API validates input and builds the prompt
IBM Granite writes the text (or a labelled demo template is used)
API validates output (length, markup, risky claims, PIN/OTP requests)
Browser shows it as a draft; vendor edits and approves; it is saved in localStorage

api.purpose: Write a message from the shop and product sent in the request body
Check a message for markup and risky claims
Government scheme names and official links
Steps and safety notes for receiving UPI payments

safeguards: Vendor approves every draft; nothing is sent, paid for or submitted automatically
Never asks for UPI PIN, OTP or passwords
Scheme information lists official links only
Generated text is labelled as an AI suggestion, not a guarantee
Input and output checked for markup (< >) and risky claims
API keys stay in server environment variables
limitations: Single vendor per browser, no login. Data is not shared between devices (use backup and restore). Add authentication and a managed database before real use.
